fixtures.source: LEARNINGS.md Phase 3 rule and the in-game screenshot held by the owner. NOTE: no layout holds an element with this class (the game adds it in code), so the check runs on a synthetic node carrying the class: it verifies the cascade (the project's rule wins over the game's), NOT that the element is the pitch container.
